kaścidbrahmeti kathitaḥ smṛtaḥ kaścidvirāḍiti ityādiprapañcitaprakāreṇa yadyadyathā
cetati tattattathā sthitimāyātīti pareṇānvayaḥ
saṃvit satyasaṃkalpasaṃvit tatsvabhāvata idaṃ viśvaṃ bhātam
ato bhrāntimātratvāddraṣṭrāditripuṭī asatyā dṛśyata iti dṛk dṛśyam

iti anayā rītyā ātivāhika ālokanamāloko bhrāntidarśanamātraṃ cetsa kaṭhinatvaṃ
śilādibhāvam
yathā hariścandrādeḥ svapnasya cirānubhavanocitaṃ puṣṭatvaṃ tathetyarthaḥ

brahmāhamiti yathārthacetanaṃ tyaktvā ayaṃ deho manuṣyādirahaṃ ayaṃ
pṛthvyādirmamādhāra iti paśyati tatra ca bhāvanāmāsthāṃ vadhnāni

teṣāṃ ca tattadupādhimati arthe saṃketaṃ
karoti saṃketena saṃjñāḥ karoti

ābrahmaṇa āmaśakāt ityanayā rītyā ādhibhautikatā kāṭhinyādisvabhāvatā ucitaiva
nānucitā

mūlabhūtādbrahmaṇaḥ sraṣṭuḥ sakāśādeva evaṃrūpo moho'yamāyāta iti hetoreṣa
jagaddarśanarūpo bhramo mahātmanāṃ tattvavidāmapi yāvatprārabdhakṣayamastītyarthaḥ

cidekarasasya brahmaṇa evaṃrūpā itthaṃ durdaśā kva vidyate kiṃtvidamakhilaṃ
saṃsāradurdaśādibhrāntireva
anāmaye kūṭasthacidānandādvaye brahmaṇi kāryatākāraṇatādisaṃbhava eva nāsti

tattasmāddhetoridaṃ jagadākāraṃ kimapi bhrāntimātramātataṃ vistṛtaṃ na vastu saditi
niṣkarṣa ityarthaḥ
